subject: a duck-shaped vessel whose handle loops through itself
pose: head turned slightly while the loop rises over its back
art_direction: 哑光红鸭的背部延伸成首尾穿插的把手，薄荷内面与黑色小眼形成精巧可爱物件。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Create a compact duck-shaped vessel in matte vermilion, with its back extending into a thick handle that passes through itself in an impossible loop. The handle interior is pale mint, revealing the twist clearly. Give the duck only a small dark eye and a short blunt beak, with no wide cartoon smile. Its head turns slightly toward the viewer as the loop rises behind it. Keep the vessel opening hidden within the loop so the object feels coherent rather than assembled from unrelated parts. Use a warm cream background, one soft shadow, and crisp silhouette edges. Fill the central three quarters of the square, leaving the loop and beak safe for a circular crop.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
